title: VisionPass Developer & Technical Whitepaper
subtitle: From physical anchor philosophy and spatial geometric math to full-stack architecture choices and high-concurrency security practices.

vision.title: Vision & Security Philosophy: Why Physical Reality as Digital Key?
vision.intro: In the digital age, we have grown accustomed to alphanumeric passwords, SMS codes, and 2FA tokens. However:
vision.traditionDesc: QR codes merely encode URLs or plaintext strings, making them vulnerable to screenshot theft and remote forwarding, completely losing physical co-presence constraints.
vision.physicalDesc: A book on your desk, an oil painting on the wall, or a metal plaque on equipment possesses unique micro-textures and lighting geometry. Only someone physically on site can capture these optical signatures.
vision.ruleDesc1: Most vision systems upload raw photos to cloud servers for inference, introducing severe privacy and compliance risks.
vision.ruleDesc2: Iron Rule 1: Raw photos never leave the user device. Decoding, resizing, grayscale conversion, and ORB feature extraction run 100% inside client browser sandboxes.
vision.ruleDesc3: Servers receive only discrete point coordinates and 256-bit BRIEF binary vectors, making it mathematically impossible to reconstruct the original image.
vision.threat1Desc: Token indexes use salted HMAC-SHA-256 hashes, and secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Plaintext is never exposed even during database compromises.
vision.threat2Desc: Full HTTPS coverage with end-to-end Server Function typed RPC contracts.
vision.threat3Desc: Enforces 2D Homography matrix inlier constraints to eliminate false matches from background noise.

algorithm.title: Core Algorithms: From ORB Descriptors to RANSAC Homography
algorithm.intro: Computer vision recognition centers on finding local invariant features robust against scale variations, rotations, and illumination changes.
algorithm.orbTitle: 1. ORB (Oriented FAST & Rotated BRIEF) Feature Extraction
algorithm.orbDesc: Introduced by Ethan Rublee et al. in 2011, ORB is orders of magnitude faster than SIFT/SURF, making real-time client-side extraction in browsers effortless:
algorithm.orbStep1Desc: Tests pixel intensity across circular neighborhoods and calculates intensity centroids to assign rotational invariance (orientation theta).
algorithm.orbStep2Desc: Steers sampling point pairs by orientation theta to generate 256-bit (32-byte) binary vectors. Distances are computed via ultra-fast bitwise Hamming operations.
algorithm.loweDesc: For every descriptor dq in the query frame, finds the nearest descriptor d1 and second-nearest d2 in the reference set.
algorithm.loweNote: If d1 and d2 distances are too close, the feature indicates repetitive textures (e.g. tile grids) and is discarded to retain only distinctive pairs.
algorithm.ransacDesc1: Even after ratio filtering, cluttered scenes can produce false positives. VisionPass enforces 2D perspective projection constraints:
algorithm.ransacDesc2: A planar object viewed from different camera angles conforms to a 3x3 Homography matrix H:
algorithm.ransacStep2: 2. Solve homography matrix H via DLT Gaussian elimination;
algorithm.ransacStep3: 3. Project all reference keypoints into the query frame and evaluate Euclidean reprojection errors;
algorithm.ransacStep4: 4. Count geometric inliers. When inliers >= 12 and ratio criteria are met, spatial consistency is verified and the secret is unlocked!

techStack.title: Full-Stack Tech Stack: Modern, Lightweight & High-Performance
techStack.tanstackDesc: Eliminates boilerplate REST APIs and manual fetch calls. Employs type-safe createServerFn RPCs with automatic tree-shaking and bundling.
techStack.opencvDesc: Isolates heavy WASM runtimes, image processing, and ORB computation into independent Worker threads, maintaining smooth 60 FPS UI response.
techStack.pureTsDesc: Zero Python or Node native C++ bindings (node-gyp). Built with pure TypeScript bitwise operations and Gaussian elimination, executing in < 5ms for Serverless & Edge.
techStack.dbDesc: Lightweight ORM combined with native Crypto modules (AES-256-GCM, HMAC-SHA-256) for AEAD encrypted storage, sliding-window rate limiting, and audit logging.

architecture.title: Code Architecture & Sequence Overview
architecture.seq1Desc: Select reference photo → Web Worker resizes to 640px and extracts ORB descriptors → bundles into OrbFeaturePayloadV1 → calls createCredentialFn → server creates passcode and encrypts secret with AES-256-GCM → saves to PostgreSQL → client generates share poster.
architecture.seq2Desc: Open camera → jsQR/BarcodeDetector captures passcode in milliseconds → camera session seamlessly transitions to ORB streaming → 800ms frame sampled to verifyCredentialFn → server evaluates RANSAC inliers → returns decrypted secret upon geometric match.
